from solution import prod_Square


def test_issue_example_25():
    """Example rule: prod_Square(25) == False."""
    expected = False  # 5*5=25, sqrt=5 prime so no a,b>1 with a^2*b^2=25
    assert prod_Square(25) == expected


def test_issue_prime_square_4():
    """Rule: 4 cannot be a product of two squares greater than 1."""
    expected = False  # 2*2=4, sqrt=2 prime so no a,b>1 with a^2*b^2=4
    assert prod_Square(4) == expected


def test_issue_prime_square_9():
    """Rule: 9 cannot be a product of two squares greater than 1."""
    expected = False  # 3*3=9, sqrt=3 prime so no a,b>1 with a^2*b^2=9
    assert prod_Square(9) == expected


def test_issue_prime_square_49():
    """Rule: 49 cannot be a product of two squares greater than 1."""
    expected = False  # 7*7=49, sqrt=7 prime so no a,b>1 with a^2*b^2=49
    assert prod_Square(49) == expected


def test_issue_just_below_true_35():
    """Rule: 35 just below 36 cannot be a product of two squares."""
    expected = False  # 36-1=35, 5*5=25 <35< 6*6=36 so not a square
    assert prod_Square(35) == expected


def test_issue_just_above_true_37():
    """Rule: 37 just above 36 cannot be a product of two squares."""
    expected = False  # 36+1=37, 6*6=36 <37< 7*7=49 so not a square
    assert prod_Square(37) == expected


def test_issue_non_square_18():
    """Rule: non-square 18 cannot be a product of two squares."""
    expected = False  # 4*4=16 <18< 5*5=25 so not a square
    assert prod_Square(18) == expected


def test_issue_composite_square_36():
    """Rule: 36 can be a product of two squares greater than 1."""
    expected = True  # 4*9=36, 2^2*3^2=36
    assert prod_Square(36) == expected


def test_issue_composite_square_100():
    """Rule: 100 can be a product of two squares greater than 1."""
    expected = True  # 4*25=100, 2^2*5^2=100
    assert prod_Square(100) == expected


def test_issue_composite_square_144():
    """Rule: 144 can be a product of two squares greater than 1."""
    expected = True  # 9*16=144, 3^2*4^2=144
    assert prod_Square(144) == expected


def test_issue_negative_minus_36():
    """Rule: negative numbers cannot be a product of two squares."""
    expected = False  # -36<0 while a^2*b^2>=0, so impossible
    assert prod_Square(-36) == expected


def test_contract_exact_bool_false():
    """Contract: prod_Square must return bool exactly, not 0/1."""
    assert prod_Square(25) is False  # 5*5=25, no split 25=1*25 excluded so False


def test_contract_exact_bool_true():
    """Contract: prod_Square must return bool exactly, not 0/1."""
    assert prod_Square(36) is True  # 4*9=36, 2^2*3^2=36 so True
